main_text.p: quid altiùs excrescit & ramos producit : עץ Arborem, Genef.i.11. Aff. בעצו In ligno suo, Hose.4.12. עֵץ Arborem tuam, Deuter.28.42. Plural. עצים Ligna, Levit.i.7. Constructi. עצי עולה Ligna holocausti, Gen.22.3. Aff. ואת עציו Et ligna ejus, Levit.14.45. Foem. עצה Lignum, Jerem.6.v.6.

עצב Doluit: Dolore affecit, vel affectus fuit, Doluit, Dolorem attulit : Praet. עצב Dolore affecit eum, 1.Reg.1.6. Partic. Praet. עצובת רוח Dolore affecta, Dolens animo, Jesa.54.6. Infinit. לבלתי עצבי Ut non afficiat dolore me, 1.Par.4.10. Niph. Praet. נעצב Dolore afficiebatur, 1.Sam.20.34. Futur. יעצב Dolore afficiatur, 1.Sam.20.3. Pih. Praeteritum, ועצבו את רוח קדשו Et dolore affecerunt Spiritum sanctum ejus, Jesa.63.10. עצבוני Dolore afficiunt me, Job.10.8. Futur. יעצבו Dolorem afferunt, Psal.56.6. Hiph. Infin. להעצבה Idololatricum cultum exhibendo ei, Jer.44.19. vel, Idola effingendo, Idolorum formam offerendo ei, juxta R.Salomonem, significatione a Nomine, quod Idolum significat, deducta. ה in fine Pronomen fœmin. est, & Mappik caret, juxta R. Davidem. Futurum, יעציבהו Dolore affecerunt eum, Psal.78. v.40. Hithp. Futur. ויתעצב אל לבו Et doluit apud animum suum, Gen.6.v.6.

עַצָּב m. Dolor, Moleftia, Psal.139.24. Aff. מעצבך A dolore tuo, Jesa.14.3. Semel Idolum, Terriculum, sic dictu, quod Dolorem potius & terrorem affert considentibus, quam levamen : עצבי Idolum meum, Jesa.48.5.

עצב עצב m. Dolor, Labor, Moleftia: Idolum, Simulachrum, ut Jer.22.28. Plur. העצבים Dolorum, Psal.127. v.2. Aff. ועצביך Et labores tui, id est, Facultates labore parta, metonymice, Prov.5.10. & sic Jesa.58.3.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points (niqqud) are not transcribed; consonants only. Several Hebrew forms are set with points that are hard to read at this scan resolution, so vowel-level detail is uncertain. "Hithp." in the abbreviation is read as printed, with doubt on the letters. Roman numerals such as "Genef.i.11." and "Levit.i.7." are read from the scan. The Hebrew headwords עץ and עצב may carry points in the original. The bottom right catchword is עצבים.
